facts: Parties: Upton Holdings Ltd (Buyer), Whitlock Industries Ltd (Seller); the Company is Oakhurst Analytics Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 9 August 2026; Closing is scheduled for 7 October 2026 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 2.3: the Purchase Price shall be reduced dollar-for-dollar by any shortfall of Closing Working Capital below the Target Working Capital of $2,000,000.
Section 12.1: the Seller shall not compete with the business for 4 years after Closing.
Section 9.7: the Buyer must notify any warranty claim within 30 days of becoming aware of it.
The estimated Closing Working Capital is $1,090,000. The Seller's draft funds flow shows an adjusted purchase price of $148,180,000.

Disclosure against Warranty 8.2 (IP): the Company's core platform software was developed in 2023 by an independent contractor, Whitlock Energy plc. No written assignment of intellectual property was entered into.
Clause 18: the Founder shall not compete with the business for 18 months after termination of employment.
Clause 5.2: a claim against the Escrow Amount must be notified within 60 days of the Buyer becoming aware of it.
